title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF achieved significant results focusing on systematic system strengthening initiatives to achieve relevant progress in foundational learning, inclusive education for CotM, access to safe WASH services and providing humanitarian assistance during emergencies. UNICEF scaled-up successful methodologies, trained thousands of teachers, used technology and innovative approaches and gender-transformative programming for MHM. Advocacy, sustained work and strategic partnerships contributed to provide inclusive education opportunities for vulnerable children.
